full_name: Asad L. Asad | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Asad L. Asad is a PhD candidate in sociology at Harvard University. His work addresses questions related to im/migration; qualitative and mixed methods; race and ethnicity; social stratification; and urban sociology.
